title: Pragmatic Gym human interpretation distribution (one row per family x cell)
description: Aggregated from N independent annotators who saw ONLY the observable conversation (exported by scripts/export_annotation_batch.py). Each annotator distributes 100 points across the interpretations; rows store the mean distribution. Read by causal/analysis.py (human-model divergence) and usable as a drop-in replacement for LSSM references.

inter_annotator.description: e.g. mean pairwise JSD, Krippendorff alpha on argmax

population.description: who annotated (recruitment, consent, stated communication norms) — never a proxy for nationality/identity
